description: A track whose file size equals the threshold exactly is included.

a.request: For tracks with a file size (`Bytes`) of at least 10323804, what is the average `UnitPrice` and the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds`, as a decimal ratio)? Ignore missing values and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice), AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804

b.request: For tracks with Bytes >= 10323804: simple average UnitPrice and average of the (Bytes/Milliseconds) ratio for each individual track (excluding tracks with NULL Bytes), expressed as decimal without rounding.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice), AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
b.raw:
For tracks with Bytes >= 10323804: simple average UnitPrice and average of the (Bytes/Milliseconds) ratio for each individual track (excluding tracks with NULL Bytes), expressed as decimal without rounding.

---

But here are all distinct interpretations of the question:

Bytes >= 10323804; simple average UnitPrice; average of individual (Bytes/Milliseconds) ratios; exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes >= 10323804; simple average UnitPrice; overall ratio (SUM Bytes / SUM Milliseconds) for large tracks; exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes >= 10323804; weighted average UnitPrice by InvoiceLine Quantity; average of individual (Bytes/Milliseconds) ratios; exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes >= 10323804; weighted average UnitPrice by InvoiceLine Quantity; overall ratio (SUM Bytes / SUM Milliseconds); exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes > 10323804; simple average UnitPrice; average of individual (Bytes/Milliseconds) ratios; exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes > 10323804; simple average UnitPrice; overall ratio (SUM Bytes / SUM Milliseconds); exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes > 10323804; weighted average UnitPrice; average of individual ratios; exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes > 10323804; weighted average UnitPrice; overall ratio; exclude tracks with NULL Bytes
Bytes >= 10323804; simple average UnitPrice; average of (Bytes/Milliseconds) treating NULL Bytes as 0
Bytes >= 10323804; simple average UnitPrice for all qualifying tracks, but only compute ratio for tracks with non-NULL Bytes in separate calculation
Include tracks with NULL Bytes in the UnitPrice average but compute separately for ratio calculation
Different interpretation of "large tracks" as qualifying by some other criterion than raw Bytes value

d.request: Tracks with Bytes >= 10323804 are considered large; return the average UnitPrice and the average of the (Bytes / Milliseconds) ratio computed per track for all large tracks, excluding tracks with missing Bytes, Milliseconds, or UnitPrice values.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice), AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL AND UnitPrice IS NOT NULL

c.request: Taking 10323804 bytes as the cutoff for a large track, what is the average `UnitPrice` of the large tracks and their average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` divided by `Milliseconds`, as a decimal ratio)? Ignore missing values and don't round. A track whose file size equals the threshold exactly is included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) as average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / Milliseconds) as average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
